subject: Urgent: Failed payment for April invoice — card update & VAT evidence
messages:
From: Helios Retail <billing@heliosretail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Torres <alex@heliosretail.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Failed payment for April invoice — need a retry link and VAT evidence

Hi Vanessa,

We received a notice that the April invoice (INV-202704) failed to collect — the card on file gave a decline at auth. Can you: 1) provide a secure link so Alex can update the card on file, 2) schedule an immediate retry for the outstanding balance, and 3) share the VAT evidence (company invoices + tax registration) for our AP team so we can reconcile?

Our payments deadline is Thursday; if this isn't resolved we may hit a temporary service disruption. Please advise the fastest path.

Thanks,
Alex Torres
Billing Manager, Helios Retail
attachments: (none)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Helios Retail <billing@heliosretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Failed payment for April invoice — need a retry link and VAT evidence

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the hiccup. Short plan below; follow-up items for our ops team are CC'd.

Plan (high level)
- I'll send a secure hosted update-payment-method link from Stripe for Alex to update the card (one-click).
- Once the card is updated we'll trigger a manual retry for invoice INV-202704 (payment ops will monitor and confirm).
- Attached is the VAT evidence pack you asked for (VAT certificate + copy of standard invoice). If you need a different format let me know.

Interim measures: if the retry fails we'll open a dispute mitigation workflow and consider a short grace credit to prevent service disruption while we collect. Monica / Rishi: can you confirm we have the retry window set to immediate and whether a temporary credit is available? Also include the Stripe payment attempt id when you have it.

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0183
attachments: vat_reverse_charge_evidence-Helios.pdf, invoice_202704-Helios.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Helios Retail <billing@heliosretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Failed payment for April invoice — need a retry link and VAT evidence

Vanessa / Alex — quick checklist from payments ops: 

1) Hosted payment method update: I will create a Stripe-hosted "Update payment method" session and send the secure link to Alex. It expires in 1 hour.
2) Retry schedule: once Alex updates the card I will immediately call Stripe to create a manual payment intent for INV-202704 and mark the invoice for an on-demand retry.
3) Chargeback mitigation: if we see a second auth decline, we'll (a) attempt a second card-present-style auth via a different processor route, (b) open a pre-emptive support ticket with Stripe and attach the commercial invoice + VAT evidence so we can attach it to dispute responses.
4) Temporary credit: Monica, per policy we have a one-off emergency 7-day service credit we can apply to avoid interruption — please confirm if we should apply it while we collect.

Alex — I will send the link in a separate email (secure). When you update, reply with the time so I can kick the retry. If you prefer, we can also accept a new payment method token via your payments admin to avoid manual entry.

Alex — link below will let you securely update the payment method on file. It expires in 60 minutes. After you update, reply to this thread and Rishi will run the retry.

Secure update link: https://pay.stripe.com/update/pm_ses_01Gk...

If you'd prefer to use a PO or wire, we can accept that as well but turnaround will be slower.

Monica — please confirm the temporary 7-day emergency credit so we can avoid a service disruption while the retry completes.

Thanks,
Vanessa
